newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Kidnappers free member of Venezuelan first family.
newsitem.headline: Kidnappers free member of Venezuelan first family.

text.p: Kidnappers freed a cousin of Venezuela's first lady late on Friday after 12 hours and without asking for a ransom payment, police said on Saturday.

Josefina Sarria Pietri de Lecuna, second cousin of President Rafael Caldera's wife, turned up in the town Villa de Cura in the central Aragua state, about 60 miles (100 km) east of the ranch from where she was snatched by five armed men early on Friday.
Sarria had not been mistreated by her kidnappers, the police spokesman said.
Three of the five kidnappers were quickly caught by police but a search continued for the other two, he said.
